name: Split hero with rotating slide gallery and botanical line-art accents
notes: Copy sits left, a fading slideshow of portrait-orientation photos sits right — good pattern for photographers/creatives where the images ARE the pitch. Inline SVG botanical sprigs (referenced via <use href="#bot-...">) are decorative flourishes defined once in a sprite sheet elsewhere on the page; this fragment references them by id but doesn't include the sprite defs. Uses <picture>/srcset for responsive art direction.
